Projects.name: Mycro 1
Projects.description: Mycro provides a centralized platform for capturing, sharing, and recognizing demos with rich context. It enables creators to submit demos easily, teams to browse and vote on standout work, and stakeholders to reuse real proof points for storytelling and alignment, turning visibility into momentum and learning across the organization.

Deliverables.description: Establish the OMS as the system of decision for order-time enforcement by creating, validating, pricing, approving, and governing sales orders with explicit, auditable decision outcomes (pricing, terms, approvals, compliance blocks) rather than implicit workflow side-effects.

Deliverables.title: Platform Administration

Tasks.description:
* Auto set end date for a project when creating. Overall in the creation process every filed should be set by default if the user does not set it.
    * when creating a project in the work breakdown stage:
        * have the new inputs be empty but be placeholders so the user can just start writing text
        * when you hit enter in an epic input have it create a new one
    * When Creating any long form we need a way to have the create button or top nav stick to the top. the example is creating Milestones and having to scroll to the top to create a new one. or having one at the top and the bottom
    * Create a way to have a custom Implementation framework where you can create the Stages and add default tasks that can be created across epic or just once.
        * Also add that functionality that you can edit and change the templated tasks before they get applied. or add some custom tasks. The templates need to be place holders.
    * Filter user select by the people who that role. This will require more work in templates and user management where they will need to do a mapping on what roles people can be assigned. maybe there is a table then a permission matrix that allows you to decide who can be assigned to that role.
    * When creating a project fix the notification that is triggered after something has been created (some times being hundreds of tasks)

FrameworkTemplates.name: Nymbl Implementation Framework
FrameworkTemplates.description: Structured 4-stage delivery framework ensuring alignment, validation, execution, and adoption.

StageTemplates.name: Plan Strategy
StageTemplates.description: Define strategic intent, scope, outcomes, and success criteria that shape the solution.
StageTemplates.entryCriteria: Business objectives captured; initial scope, risks, and desired outcomes drafted.
StageTemplates.exitCriteria: Strategic intent validated; Problem-Solution Analysis approved; high-level capabilities identified.

StageTemplates.name: Validate Blueprint
StageTemplates.description: Confirm detailed, testable requirements aligned to business objectives and solution feasibility.
StageTemplates.entryCriteria: Strategic direction approved; scope and capabilities defined.
StageTemplates.exitCriteria: Requirements validated; blueprint finalized and approved.

StageTemplates.name: Develop Solution
StageTemplates.description: Develop and integrate capabilities that fulfill validated requirements.
StageTemplates.entryCriteria: Blueprint, requirements, and technical plan approved.

StageTemplates.name: Enable Users
StageTemplates.description: Equip users to adopt, operate, and sustain the solution effectively.
StageTemplates.entryCriteria: Features validated and ready for user adoption.
StageTemplates.exitCriteria: Users trained; documentation published; support model live.
